user.title: Connect to Telos
user.description: Enter your Telos server URL and the email you sign in with. Home Assistant signs in as you with a magic link, the same way the Telos app does.

data_description.url: Base URL of your Telos server, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3001
data_description.email: The address of your Telos account

link.title: Paste the magic link
link.description: Telos has made a magic link for {email}. Telos has no mail provider, so the link is printed in the Telos server's log (and pre-filled here when the server exposes it). Paste the whole link or just its token.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Telos again
reauth_confirm.description: The Home Assistant session for {url} has expired. Request a new magic link to sign in again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Telos server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_link: That magic link is invalid or has expired (links last 15 minutes). Start again to get a new one.
error.request_refused: Telos refused to send a magic link. Too many sign-in attempts? Wait 15 minutes and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Telos account is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: That magic link signed in a different Telos account than this entry belongs to.
